sourceReview.reason: Rechecked 2026-11-15 after prior six-hour hold. Earlier Crypto.news Sept 13 (https://crypto.news/base-tokenized-stock-volume-reaches-100-million/) verifies historical Base trading, not this Nov 13 weekly window. No accessible original Token Terminal or Base data snapshot independently supports the exact $850m weekly claim with three fresh facts. Remains held; retry no sooner than 2026-11-16T00:18:00Z.
